notes.title: DoDonPachi Resurrection Ver 1.0.6.0 An Update & Apology
notes.content:
We just updated DoDonPachi again following the previous fix for Hibachi.
Unfortunately, after investigation and a lot of help from both players (especially KAL & 旭日之心) and Cave's staff, we were able to ascertain that the problem was down to a simple mistake on our part.
Needless to say, the current version has been re-checked and Hibachi is confirmed working in Arrange A.

Apologies from all at Degica.

notes.title: DoDonPachi Resurrection Ver 1.0.6.0 Arrange A Hidden Boss Fix
notes.content:
We just released a patch with the following fixes included:

[list]
[*]Fix for Hibachi not appearing in Arrange A
[*][strike]Fix for Hibachi not appearing in Training Mode[/strike]
[/list]

Edit: Hibachi was previously working in Training Mode.

Two things of note about the above fix:

1) When replayed in today's version, any pre-existing replays where the player fulfilled conditions for Hibachi to appear will see Hibachi appear, but due to no input history having been recorded for Hibachi, the player will be destroyed.

2) As scores attained with previous versions will not include any points for battling/defeating Hibachi, players of today's version will not be disadvantaged, so we decided to leave previous scores as is rather than wipe everyone's hard work.

As always, if you experience any problems post patch, please let us know.

notes.title: DoDonPachi Resurrection Ver 1.0.5.1 BL Arrange Slowdown
notes.content:
We just released a patch with the following fixes included:

[list]
[*]Fix for specific slowdown in Black Label Arrange
Excessive slowdown which occured specifically in Black Label Arrange when holding Auto and Shot together (i.e. during Red Mode) has been lessened, briing it more in line with other modes.
[*]Leaderboard reset for Black Label Arrange
In the interest of fairness, due to the change in difficulty with the above fix, Black Label Arrange leaderboards have been reset. Apologies for this.
[*]Language check on first boot
The game now checks language setting of Steam (English or Japanese) and starts the game in the appropriate language. NB: if you have already booted the game once, the language setting in the save data will be used.
[/list]

notes.title: DoDonPachi Resurrection update news (11th Nov)
notes.content:
First off, as always, a huge thank you for playing and enjoying DoDonPachi Resurrection on Steam.

As promised [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/464450/announcements/detail/818919582817197653]last week[/url], we have an update for you all today; details below.

[list]
[*]Fix for crash on boot/game start related to number of friends (1)
This related to a certain set of conditions including number of friends and hardware setup.
[*]Fix for menu layouts when rotating screen to vertical and switching Rotate Link 'On'
[*]Fix for some set-ups accepting control input whilst window was not in focus 
[*]Fix for drop in FPS after uploading scores (2)
[*]Fix for scores not being uploaded to the leaderboard correctly
Scores for individual areas should now be correctly registering.
[/list]
(1) & (2) 
We are aware similar issues exist in both Mushihimesama and Deathsmiles and will be looking into whether the same fix can be applied to both those games too.
* If any of the above issues should persist, please contact us with details [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/464450/discussions/0/341537388322245033/]here.[/url] 

Next, a word from Degica:
As we announced last week, we're working with Cave's development team to check all the reports and requests you've been sending and this is still ongoing after today's update. One issue we have received many requests about is slow down and we want you to know we don't take your reports lightly.

In relation to this, one thing we would like your understanding on is that although the Steam version is [i]based[/i] on the Xbox 360 version of the game, it has been newly ported to the PC meaning they are not one and the same thing.
This is why you will notice slowdown occurs (or not) in different places and at differing times to the Xbox 360 version. It also means, unfortunately, that making the Steam version identical to the Xbox 360 in this respect is a difficult undertaking.

Having said that, we also realise for some of you, this is a very important element of the game, so we, along with Cave, will continue to investigate what can be done with regards this issue.

Thanks for your understanding and we will keep you all updated with regards future updates as soon as we know.
